text: Mertle Murkpen is a Forsaken inscription supplies vendor in the Pools of Vision of Thunder Bluff. She stands near Poshken Hardbinder, Master Inscription Trainer and the Lexicon of Power.
Mental Dexterity is a Shaman talent designed to increase attack power by some percentage of your intellect.

__NOTOC__ The ghost of Merchant Kendra stands in the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains. She and the other Highborne ghosts in the ruins appear to be constantly reliving certain moments from their lives. Kendra was a merchant seen trying to sell her wares to a couple of Highborne Citizens.
Mesmerized Children are pandaren found alongside Excited Onlookers wherever Jojo Ironbrow is showing off his strength on the Wandering Isle.
Merra Finklestorm is a gnome located by Waina Steelpaw in the Shrine of Seven Stars.

Merciless Gladiator Saifu is a blood elf or night elf (depending on the race of the player) priest that is a part of the Uber Town group. She can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.
Mephitic Reins of Dark Portent are sold by Zan Shivsproket for after completing Power Ascended on Fangs of the Devourer.
Mercurial Guardians are quilen briefly located in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. They appear only during Voice of the Gods.

Meredith the Crone is a Forsaken located in Ar'gorok in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. She provides powers from the Altar of Storms for 10 iron (Warfronts), wood (Warfronts), and one Essence of Storms.
Merger Specialist Huzzle is a goblin of the Venture Company ecountered during Island Expeditions.

Merla is Murky's cousin that got lost and ended up in the Redridge Mountains and had a tadpole. Murky used this information to get the Everstill murlocs to fight the Hidden and the Burning Legion at the Hidden citadel in Hellfire Peninsula.
Might of the Timbermaw is a Leatherworking-crafted belt that give bonuses to Strength and Stamina.

Midnight is 's personal mount, with which he used to terrorize intruders and fight his enemies. She is known as one of the (if not the) fastest and strongest existing horses. A local rumor says that a supernatural mount still haunts the domain, in search of a worthy rider, most notably Midnight after the death of her rider. She is a neutral boss in Karazhan and attacking her starts the Attumen encounter. Attumen can drop Midnight as a mount, as Fiery Warhorse's Reins.
Midnight Orbs drop from Blackrock Shadowcasters in the Redridge Mountains.

micro menu]] micro menu with unread community posts]] The Micro Menu, also known as the Interface Panel, is a collection of small buttons located between the main Action Bar and the character's bag slots. The buttons open various UI panels. Interface Panel: These tabs enable you to access your character information, spellbook and abilities window, character talents, quest log, world map, social options, the main menu, and GM support.

Mi'irku Farstep is a level 63 portal trainer located at the top room of the Seer's Library in the neutral Shattrath City, which you can reach by going up the ramp on the west side of the building. She is aligned with the Scryers. However, the portal she teaches transports your party to the Terrace of Light in Shattrath, which is neutral territory, so your Aldor friends will be safe.
The Might of Hakkar is a Level 50 quality One-Handed Mace that improves Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.
.]] In Message to Freewind Post, you must carry an urgent message from Brave Moonhorn to Cliffwatcher Longhorn, the leader of Freewind Post, regarding the recent activities of the centaurs.

Midsummer Sausages are a reward from the following Midsummer Fire Festival quests: *Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms *Flickering Flames in Kalimdor *Stealing Darnassus's Flame *Stealing the Undercity's Flame

Midsummer Suppliers can be found by bonfires in Alliance capital cities. It is worth noting, that while they can be aggroed, and hit, they cannot be killed, stopping at 1% health. For this reason, they may want to be avoided while stealing flames. This can also be used to cause a never-ending battle by pulling Midsummer Merchants/Suppliers of the opposing faction into a friendly city.

:Were you looking for the alliance midsummer vendor? See Midsummer Supplier. Midsummer Merchant can be found by bonfires in Horde capital cities. It is worth noting, that while they can be aggroed, and hit, they cannot be killed, stopping at 1% health. For this reason, they may want to be avoided while stealing flames. This can also be used to cause a never-ending battle by pulling Midsummer Merchants/Suppliers of the opposing faction into a friendly city.
The Midwall Lift is a lift designed to transport vrykul from the cliffs to the ocean and is located east of Nifflevar in the Howling Fjord.
Metamorphosis is a Demonology warlock ability, available at level 10.
Michael Corpora is a crewman of the Assurance found in Stormwind Harbor of Stormwind City.

Messner is a human mage quest giver and an important character in the Redridge Mountains storyline. He is a member of John J. Keeshan's group Bravo Company. He perished along with his other squadmates except for John J. Keeshan and the player character during the encounter with Darkblaze.

Michael Bedernik is a worgen found in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He can be seen either in his human form or in the worgen form. Sitting at a table with Wilhem Ken, who he frequently gets into an argument with. : : :Wilheim laughs. : : walks over. :
Metabolic Boost is an ability used by Zergling during a Pet Battle.
Meteor Strike is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Metal Fist is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Michael Stackpole is a science fiction and fantasy author best known for his Star Wars and Battletech books. He was born in Wausau, Wisconsin, but raised in Vermont. He has a BA in history from the University of Vermont. His first World of Warcraft work is Vol'jin: Shadows of the Horde. He played the game for a month straight after getting the job, making a number of characters and jokingly saying he could excuse himself for playing by calling it "research." According to Stackpole, he was also chosen thanks to an acquaintanceship from Cryptozoic (Warcraft TCG) and Blizzard like his previous books. After signing the contract, he had to participate in a course of "introductory of Warcraft's hi
Mifan is a pandaren food and drink vendor, located in the Summer's Rest inn, inside the Shrine of Two Moons. She tended to Wrathion during his stay at the inn after the war against the Jailer.
Michi Windblossom is a pandaren flight master located at Tushui Landing on the Timeless Isle.
Mighty Charge is an ability used by Grommloc during a Pet Battle.

Micah Belford is an undead who briefly appears at Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. He is a member of the Cult of Forgotten Shadows, guards the body of Natalie Seline and assists the High Priest of the Conclave in reviving her.
Midnight Black Reins of Dark Portent are sold by Zan Shivsproket for after completing Power Ascended on The Kingslayers.

Michaela Nienaber is Associate Concept Artist for World of Warcraft at Blizzard Entertainment since July 2014. She worked on early vrykul and Highmountain tauren design exploration for World of Warcraft: Legion.
Metreon was the doomguard who rallied the satyr in Felwood and launched an attack on Moonglade. He was killed by the druids of Val'sharah.

__NOTOC__ Michiel Voidstrider (real name Percival Humperdunk) is a human located in Silithus: The Wound. When Sargeras destroyed Silithus in a last-ditch attempt to kill Azeroth, most of the local Twilight's Hammer cultists were killed in the attack. However, a few still survived and were led by Michiel. Michiel was killed by adventurers before he could rally the cult into action.

The Mightstone are a group of drogbar inhabiting Highmountain. They also have a presence in Stormheim. Ahead of the Game implicitly sets them up as the main drogbar tribe, though they share Neltharion's Lair with the Understone, which may or may not be Dargrul's tribe.
Michaela Reed is a Forsaken flight master located in Timberfell Outpost in Tiragarde Sound.
Mew is a manasaber located in the Midnight Court in the Court of Stars.

Micro Zoox is a gnome located at the Gnomeregan instance portal in Dun Morogh. He is a chief engineer in charge of keeping things "under control" in Gnomeregan, and has offered Tizzy Gearjolt and Radek Fuselock his help in finding the cause of recent electrical usage spikes in the city's more dangerous areas. He also appears in the Gnomeregan pet battle scenario. This scenario can only be entered by talking to Zoox.
Midnight Masterpieces is a gallery store located in Artisan's Gallery of Suramar City in Suramar.
Metal Detector has a chance to drop from Data Anomalies on Mechagon Island.
Microbot Superchargers are alarm-o-bots located on Mechagon Island.
Microbot Shielders are alarm-o-bots located on Mechagon Island.

__NOTOC__ Mevris Ghostdancer is a night elf located at the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah. He was apparently originally from Kalimdor, but traveled to the Broken Isles in order to fight the demons. As of the Fourth War, Mevris remained in Val'sharah, and he and the other night elves of the Temple established trade relations with the neighboring Gilnean village of Bradensbrook, sending and receiving supplies to and from each other via ships. He later helped his wife Daniss Ghostdancer acquire the raw materials necessary to empower the Drums of Primal Might against the Horde.
Mighty Minions of Mechagon is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating a series of mechanized minions on Mechagon Island.
.]] Microbots are miniature robots found on Mechagon Island. They can have a two eyes, have a tesla coil, be alarm-o-bots or spraybots with the difference being their upper part, or the "head".
Miggi is a gnome located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. Mangeclaw is sleeping next to her.
Mi'kai is a vorkai located at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald. She plays the roles of Argus, a Zandalari captain and Tyrande Whisperwind.

Mi'kai, As Argus is a exploration achievement that doesn't appear to be available. Instead, there's a single achievement for participating in all of the performances at the Star Lake Amphitheater: Ardenweald's a Stage.
Might of the Worldsplitter is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Messana is an aranakk located next to Grimshadow in Keres' Rest in Maldraxxus while the world quest Drawing Out the Poison is available. Messana also participates in the assault on the House of Rituals during The Third Fall of Kel'Thuzad. They are initially found at the southern entrance to the house alongside Aran, until Draka orders the two of them to take their forces from the House of Eyes over the mountains and harry the Ritualist back lines. Messana and Aran subsequently move southeast to a platform where they remain standing for the rest of the assault.
Miasma-Lacquered Jerkin is dropped by Hungering Destroyer in Castle Nathria.
Mighty Pour is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Celestial Infusion.
Mi'kai's Deathscythe drops from Mi'kai, As Argus, the Unmaker at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald.
__NOTOC__ Mighty Mammoth Ribs are a cooking ingredient in Dragonflight Cooking. They drop from mammoths and magmammoths in the Dragon Isles.

Messenger Ohuna are ohuna located near Carseng in southern Teerakai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. There are normally two of them perched on the surrounding outcroppings. Periodically, a third ohuna spawns and lands next to the Flight Master's Assistant. She interacts with it (ostensibly meant to show her fastening a message to it) before it flies off and despawns.
__NOTOC__ Meticulously-Tuned Gear is an optional crafting reagent used in some Dragonflight Engineering recipes; taught by Schematic: Meticulously Tuned Gear.
Mighty Chain Footpads drop from Brogrul the Mighty in the Snowblind Cliffs in Highmountain.
Michael Bell is a voice actor who has provided several voices for the Warcraft universe and Diablo franchise.

Micky Neilson was previously the Lead Writer in Publishing at Blizzard Entertainment and Story Lead for Hearthstone. He had also been Senior Writer and Voice Director at Blizzard, authoring comics and short stories set in Blizzard's three main universes. His work mostly involved expanded fiction outside of the game, but he had minor contributions to in-game content. It is known that he wrote the unit lines for Warcraft III and StarCraft II. Having worked at Blizzard since 1993, Neilson left the company on March 25, 2016. Neilson worked on a range of titles, including World of Warcraft, the Warcraft RTS games, the Diablo series, the StarCraft series, and earlier titles such as The Lost Viking

Mind Blast is a priest direct-damage spell. It is a quick and powerful attack with a small cooldown, and also generates insanity for Shadow priests. While initially available to all priests, Holy Fire replaces Mind Blast at level 19 for Holy priests.

Mind Control (or MC) is a priest class talent that allows a unit to temporarily take control of a non-friendly target and use it against other enemies. It can last up to 30 seconds against monsters or 8 seconds against players. Mind Control can be used on most non-mechanical targets, including players, mobs and critters. Bosses, battle pets and some other targets are immune. Mind Control has a number of uses in both PvE and PvP, as a form of crowd control, for dealing damage and even for healing. As one of priests' most unique abilities, its use can mean elation and victory for the caster and frustration and death for the unwilling recipient, and serves to illustrate the darker side of the p
__NOTOC__ Miles Dexter is a Forsaken rogue trainer located in the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.
Miner Cromwell was a Forsaken quest giver located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.

__NOTOC__ Mildred Fletcher is a human bandage trainer located on the upper floor of the Shattrath Infirmary in Shattrath's Lower City. The children at the Shattrath orphanage speak fondly of her. She once took care of one child's father when he was hurt.
__NOTOC__ Minalei is a draenei innkeeper located in the Aldor Rise inn in Shattrath City.
Mind Freeze is a death knight ability that interrupts casting and prevents spells from that school from being cast for 3 seconds.

Mind Amplification Dish is an engineer-only permanent "enchant" to belts, that adds the ability to mind control your opponents. The recipe for this item is learned from Grand Master Engineering trainers.
Mimbihi is a jungle troll barmaid of the Filthy Animal inn located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary within the mage city of Dalaran.
Mijiri is a draenei battlemaster located in Shattrath's Lower City.

The Military District is the southeastern section of Gilneas City. It apparently was focused on the Gilnean military. It connects to Merchant Square to the north, and Greymane Court to the west. Stoneward Prison is a prominent feature here. An arsenal in Josiah Avery's cellar is also in this district.
Mind Surge is a passive Shadow priest ability, available at level 26.
Min the Breeze Rider is a pandaren flight master with the Anglers found at Soggy's Gamble in the Dread Wastes.
Minefield is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Mingus Diggs and his four statues (Remains of Ajassa, The Golden Ram of Nahom, The Untiring Watcher, The Obsidian Peregrine) comprise one of the special Rank 9 Challenge Card encounters in the Brawler's Guild. To fight him, players must use Challenge Card: Mingus Diggs, purchased from the card trader in the arena. To unlock the ability to purchase the challenge card, players must first find the Digmaster's Earthblade from Tol'vir dig sites in Uldum, or from inside a Crate of Tol'vir Archaeology Fragments.
Mind Quickening is a passive Shadow priest ability, improving haste and multistrike for party and raid members.
The Mindforged Hippogryphs were hippogryphs found in the city of Suramar.
The Mindshattered Screecher is an owl located in Darkheart Thicket.
Mind-numbing Poison III could previously be crafting using the Rogue Poisons ability.
Miju is a tortollan located on a small island south-west of Xibala in Zuldazar.

Mina Fintallas is the wife of Parqual Fintallas and the mother of Philia. Before the Third War, the Fintallas family lived in their modest but comfortable chambers in Capital City. When Parqual would spend the night working, Mina would sometimes send Philia to deliver him his supper. After Parqual became an undead, he was unsure whether Mina was dead or an undead monstrosity.
Milk Pail is provided by Marie Davenport to collect Mountain Goat Milk from Mother Goats for Milking Goats.

Mike Murphy is a database engineer at Blizzard Entertainment. He helps tune, upgrade, and safeguard the databases powering Blizzard's games. He worked as a tech support for desktop printers while attending school until he found out that Blizzard was hiring for technical support reps.
Militia Commanders were powerful human militia leaders appearing in King Arthas. They were slain along their men by Arthas Menethil and his Scourge forces.
Miju's Retreat is a island in Zuldazar. As its name indicates, it is Miju's retreat.
Milnar Danspark is a Mechagon mechagnome located in High Tinkertory in Mechagon City.
Millie Howell is a human child located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.
Mind Exploder is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mindmancer Handgloves is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mind Breach is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Millbert is a human located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City. He is one of Onnesa's workers and tried to steal Seabraid Merchandise.
Mind Flay: Insanity is a shadow priest ability enabled by the Surge of Insanity talent.
Mind Spike: Insanity is a shadow priest ability enabled by the Surge of Insanity talent.

Mimiron's Jumpjets is a mount awarded to players who solve the Secrets of Azeroth using clues posted by content creators from 7-10 September 2023. The mount parts (and mount) are available to players even after the event has concluded. After acquiring all three parts, head to by the weekly profession questgivers at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken and use one one of the parts at the Empowered Arcane Forge to form the mount.

The Mirage Flats were located east of Dustbelch Grotto in the Badlands and was populated by coyotes. During the Cataclysm, the area was destroyed by Deathwing as it lied in the south west of the path of destruction that makes up the Scar of the Worldbreaker.
Mirkfallon Dryads are located in the Talon Den in Stonetalon Mountains.
Mirkfallon Keepers are located in the Talon Den in Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Mishellena is a night elf hippogryph flight master located at Talonbranch Glade in Felwood.

.]] :The slower the death, the more agonizing the pain Misery is a Tier 8 Priest talent in the Shadow tree. It causes the Priest's Mind Blast, Mind Flay and Mind Sear spells to give the target a debuff that increases spell damage taken by 5/10/15% of the Priests total spellpower. Your Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay and Vampiric Touch also increase the chance for harmful spells to hit by 1/2/3%, lasting 24 seconds. Misery benefits all other casters in the party or raid as it increases the chance for spells to hit.
Minions of Omen are wolves that appear during the Lunar Festival in Moonglade. They serve the evil demigod Omen.

Recipes in Mining are listed under Smelting, a subskill which works exactly like any other crafting-profession. Although working like a separate profession, Smelting is part of Mining, and is automatically learned upon obtaining Mining. It's the ability which allows a player to process and refine raw ores into useful bars. Smelting is also often used to combine smelted metals into alloys. While many of the recipes give skillups, skill in Mining will normally improve by gathering ores. Processing materials in Smelting requires a forge.

Misconceptions is chapter 1 of Curse of the Blood Elves. It was a large engagement waged between the crumbling Alliance, under the command of Grand Marshal Garithos, and the Scourge for control of the ruined city of Dalaran.
Minion of Doane is an abomination spawned by Grand Magus Doane in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge Mountains.

Minshina is the brother of Master Gadrin, who is in charge of Sen'jin Village in Durotar. At some point, he was captured and killed by the evil warlock, Zalazane. Unfortunately for Minshina, death was not the end, for his soul was trapped within his skull by the magics of Zalazane. Through dreams, Minshina revealed his fate to his brother and Master Gadrin sent Horde adventurers to the Echo Isles who were able to successfully free him from his imprisonment.
Mirkfallon Post is an Alliance camp located south of Mirkfallon Lake in Stonetalon Mountains. The camp is apparently directed by two scout leaders.
__NOTOC__ Minx is a gnome found enslaved by the Horde in Ashenvale near Silverwind Refuge. Some time later after being rescued she ends up in Stonetalon Mountains as a quest giver.

once was.]] The Mirage Abyss is the series of underwater canyons created during the Shattering. They're found throughout the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles with several Southsea Treasure Hunters within them trying to collect the treasure chests that were lost when the giant Whale Shark sank one of their ships. An excellent place to harvest Stranglekelp.

A miser's forge is a device spoken of in tavern tales, always owned by "a friend of a friend." Few can claim to have seen one with their own eyes, although its handiwork does appear in marketplaces from time to time. The device described in the stories is a small, phlogiston-powered forge that melts down a coin of a high denomination and then use the resulting metal to gild lower-value coins — creating surprisingly effective forgeries. A single gold piece melted in a miser's forge can cover up to five coins. The coins covered are typically of lower denomination, used to defraud merchants. However, on occasion coins are discovered with gilding that makes them appear cheaper (suc as gold coins
The MiniZep Controller was the Feast of Winter Veil gift for 2010, found in Winter Veil Gift. Using it summons a MiniZep with the following abilities: * * *
Minions of Siamat are elite air elementals that appear during the fight with Siamat in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
Mirkin is a level 28 goblin vendor at the Horde outpost of Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains. He sells basic food and drinks, trade supplies, reagents, and poisons.
__NOTOC__ Mirin is a forest nymph found at Thal'darah Overlook in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Recipes in Mining are listed under Smelting, a subskill which works exactly like any other crafting-profession. Although working like a separate profession, Smelting is part of Mining, and is automatically learned upon obtaining Mining. It's the ability which allows a player to process and refine raw ores into useful bars. Smelting is also often used to combine smelted metals into alloys. While many of the recipes give skillups, skill in Mining will normally improve by gathering ores. Processing materials in Smelting requires a forge.
__NOTOC__ Miralisse is a blood elf tailoring trainer and vendor located on Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City.
Mirkfallon Post Scouts are night elves found at Mirkfallon Post within the Stonetalon Mountains. They protect the entrance to the Post.
The Miniature Iron Star only spawns in the heroic and mythic version of Upper Blackrock Spire, in the room before the Warlord Zaela.
Minions of Weavil were gnomes, humans and dwarves (with earthen textures) found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. They worked for Doctor Weavil.
Miniaturizers were sold for by Fitzi Gearwobble and Goldo Fizzcrackle during Island Expeditions.
Miniature Stag Skull can be obtained from the Ensorcelled Chest in the mountains near Fletcher's Hollow of Drustvar.

Techniques in Mining are listed under Mining skills. In general, the ability to mine mining nodes is automatically gained when new proficiencies are learnt . Techniques are passively applied bonuses that provide more or different resources when looting the specific node. When available, each node has three ranks of proficiency.
Minor Corruption is a blood orb located in Nazmir. After the Horde adventurer found it, it destroyed itself.
Mire Whelks are snails located in Nazmir and found during Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Miniaturized Power Cores drop from Sabertrons in Stormsong Valley and P4-N73R4 in Tiragarde Sound.
Mirage-Weaver's Gauntlets drop from Fury of N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Mirrors of Spell Turning are sold for by Arcanist Tero'shan and Vazun Starspeaker during Island Expeditions.
Minor Hexes are flying tomes located in the Grove of Memory in Ardenweald.
Miniaturized Steam Turbine is looted from Dredged Canisters on Mechagon Island.
Mirewood the Trampler is an ancient located in the Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Mire Priest Vassz is a saurok located in Island Expeditions.
Miri's Chapel located in northeastern Bastion, accessible from the ground only from a teleport pad in front of Covinkle's Workshop.
__NOTOC__ Mischievous Sprites are sprites disguising as Soothoof Hillstriders in the Ettinwalk in Highmountain. They are revealed when the hillstriders are dispelled.
Miniature Bronze Dragonflight Banner is located in Thaldraszus.
Mining Field Notes are a reward from the following quests: *A Fiery Flight *All Mine, Mine, Mine *The Call of the Forge *The Weight of Earth

The Mistress of Torment was a malevolent queen of suffering, the greatest of the sayaad who found their way to Outland. She served as one of Magtheridon's generals. In her chamber, she held many torture devices and Cages of Discipline. When Illidan and his allies came to Outland and laid siege to Black Temple, the Mistress of Torment was called to guard one of the two Shadowkeys needed to unlock the inner sanctum. Vashj and her naga infiltrated the aqueducts and attacked the Black Temple from a side entrance, as Akama and his draenei destroyed the automated defenses. Vashj then proceeded and defeated the Mistress of Torment with the aid of her naga. With her soul traveling back to the Twisti

Mistresses of the Mines are shivarra quest givers located by the two entrances to the Netherwing Mines in Shadowmoon Valley. She is friendly to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing.

in Darkshore.]] Mist Veil is one of several sunken frigates in Darkshore, and whose lockboxes are the objective of the quest Deep Ocean, Vast Sea. It was attacked and sunk by murlocs as it was approaching Auberdine after having crossed the Great Sea. Some of the crew survived by swimming ashore, but the captain went down with the ship. The Mist Veil lies just north of Silver Dawning.
Missing: Corporal Keeshan is a notice board outside the inn of Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. The point of this sign is to info the player of a hidden quest giver north of town.
Missing Parts were located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.

The Mistress of Shadows was an elven spellcaster within the Tomb of the Ancients in Dustwallow Marsh, the abode of the undead Lord Talendar. Unlike her host, the Mistress of Shadows nor her six Maidens of Shadows remained alive, and she studied within one of the Tomb's libraries. Despite the shadow and arcane powers at her command, she was slain by Rexxar and his companions during the events of the Founding of Durotar.
Mist Creepers are mistlurkers that wander around the Amberfly Bog in the Jade Forest. They are required to be slain for their heart in order to make Dream Brew for potency.
Miss Mayhem is a goblin quest giver located within the Deadmines. She'd like nothing better than to have the Foe Reaper 5000 destroyed so she can make some profit on her own reapers.
Missy Pickwicker is a gnome located in the Shrine of Seven Stars. She also appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight where she can be saved.
Mistblade Rippers are saurok that live in Lake of Stars located in Dread Wastes.
The Mistblade Scale-Lord is a saurok located in Mistblade Den at the Lake of Stars in the Dread Wastes.

The Mistblade tribe of saurok is a small, but fierce, tribe living in the Dread Wastes that revere the amber nearly as much as the mantid. Their only territory in the area lies around the Lake of Stars and their underground den.
Miss Jadepaw is a pandaren found in the Chamber of Masters in the Shrine of Two Moons.

__NOTOC__ A Mist-Shaman's Torch is a torch carried used by the Osul tribe's Mist-Shamans, led by Jahesh of Osul, in the Lower and Upper Sumprushes. They were the Mist-Shamans' source of power, and were being used to drain the energy from the Mistwalkers of Townlong Steppes.
Mist Fox Kits are foxes found in Stormheim and Highmountain.

The mists of Pandaria were magical mists conjured by the last Emperor of Pandaria, Shaohao. They protected the inhabitants of the lands during the Great Sundering of Kalimdor, at the end of the War of the Ancients.

Mistfall Cleft is a canyon in northern Tiragarde Sound and the home of the Grimestone troggs. The cleft is carved into the mountainside itself, with many caves dotting the cliff face and providing shelter to the large Grimestone population. The area is also home to many saurolisk, whom the troggs tame and ride into battle against their foes. In the past, the grandfather of the current Lord Aldrius Norwington drove the Grimestone tribe from the surrounding area and into Mistfall Cleft to found Norwington Estate, where they remained contained. However, the troggs' proximity to the new estate would make conflict with the humans inevitable. Eventually, the Grimestone launched major raids from th
Misshapen Mirror is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mistblade Den is a cave found at the south-eastern edge of the Lake of Stars in the Dread Wastes. It serves as a base of operations for the Mistblade tribe.
Mist Turtles were dragon turtles that would have been found in the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain.
Moam is an obsidian destroyer boss found in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

The Misty Reed Strand is the gloomy coastline of the Swamp of Sorrows. There is little along the vast stretch of beach but driftwood, debris, and crocolisks, crabs, murlocs, and gilblins. In recent years, the Steamwheedle Cartel's resort town of Bogpaddle was built on the northern edge with a full harbor, and several smaller encampments were started to the south. However the goblins have encountered unexpected opposition in the local coastal wildlife, and several of their camps have been viciously destroyed. An unnatural force has been driving the swamp creatures mad, and Baba Bogbrew, enlisted by the Steamwheedle Cartel, intends to find out why... Prior to Cataclysm, adventurers of the Alli
The Mithril Coif is a mail helmet made by Blacksmiths which provide a bonus to stamina and attack power.
Mithril Scale Shoulders are Blacksmithing-created mail shoulder that give a bonus to stamina and Attack power.
Mitsuwa is a jungle troll quest giver located at Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale. Before the Shattering he could be found in Zoram'gar Outpost.

The mo'arg are powerful and highly intelligent demon members of the Burning Legion. They are extremely diverse, with subspecies ranging from stunted gan'arg and imposing felguard to colossal brutes and fel lords. A demonic species hailing from the Twisting Nether, the mo'arg were some of Sargeras' opponents when he was still the defender of the Pantheon. After Sargeras betrayed the Pantheon, the highly resourceful and industrious mo'arg were recruited into the Legion to serve as armorers, forging fel-infused weaponry and constructs to besiege the worlds of the cosmos.

Misty Reed Post was a small Horde outpost of Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows. It lied between the Stagalbog and the southern Misty Reed Strand. It was guarded by Tok'Kar, along with Katar, some Stonard Hunters and a Stonard Shaman. Tok'Kar dreams that one day the post will get a burrow or at least a tower. There is no flight path from here. Prior to the Cataclysm, quests were available here, but the Post became unused in-game. By the time of the Fourth War, a farm had already been built in its place.

__NOTOC__ Mmmrrrggglll is the chieftain of the Grimscale tribe of murlocs who are situated at both the Tranquil Shore and the Golden Strand. It is possible that he was the one responsible for the theft of cargo from Captain Kelisendra's ship. To find him, simply keep an eye throughout the Golden Strand as he wanders the length of the murloc camps on the shoreline. He can easily be recognized by his somewhat unique colors. When low on health, he will heal himself back up to full health using Healing Wave. However, he only appears to do this once or twice in any given fight. He also utilizes the shaman abilities Frost Shock and Chain Lightning. He can be seen fighting the forces of Deathwingur

Moa'ki Harbor is a tuskarr port in south-central Dragonblight. It is the single largest remaining settlement the tuskarr have since they lost Kaskala, which was their capital, to the kvaldir. The sky over the harbor is always fluttering with the tuskarr's brightly colored kites, even during troubled times. It's a lively place for trade and friendly conversation, and it's bursting with storytellers. The giant sea turtle Green Island who travels the route to Kamagua in Howling Fjord stops here, as does Walker of Waves, who travels the route to Unu'pe in Borean Tundra. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard visited the port, where they enjoyed the tuskarr's hospitality a
__NOTOC__ Modoru is a draenei vendor at Star's Rest in the Dragonblight.

Mixology is a passive ability available to Alchemists. With it, any flask or elixir that can be created by the Alchemist has double duration (2 hours) when it is consumed by them. In addition, the effect is increased somewhat as well, with the amount of increase varying from item to item.

Mithril Pocketwatch was a possible drop from Coren Direbrew in the Grim Guzzler of Blackrock Depths during Brewfest 2009 and 2010. The abilities of this item are identical to those of the Sundial of the Exiled.
Mixi Sweetride is a goblin flight master located at Fuselight in the Badlands.
Mistweaver Monks are pandaren found in Thunderpaw Refuge and on the destroyed ships in Sri-La Village in the Jade Forest.

__NOTOC__ Misty Pigment is obtained from milling herbs native to Pandaria. Milled from any Pandaria herb as a secondary pigment with a lower probability of drop. However, certain herbs give better results, notably: * Fool's Cap * Desecrated Herb * Silkweed
Mistweaver Nian is a pandaren seen in the Brewmoon Festival scenario.
Mistwalker is a feats of strength achievement earned for attaining one or more realm-best times during the Challenge Mode season.
Mo'jimba is a jungle troll flight master located at Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.
The Model GU-4RD-3R is a mechanical wolf found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.

__NOTOC__ Misty Coast is the shoreline north of Feltotem in western Highmountain. It is inhabited by falcosaurs and sea giants. The Feltotem Caverns are found here. The nearby Feltotem tribe placed fel totems on the shore in order to corrupt the feathered animals.
Mo'arg Destroyers are mo'arg brutes located in Stormheim during the Legion Assaults.
Mixed Ocean Schools can be found in the waters of the Cape of Stranglethorn and Northern Stranglethorn.
Mjordin Water Magi are vrykul located at Jotunheim in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
The Mobile Teleporter was a transportation device, set up by Magni Bronzebeard, in the Harbormaster's Office in Boralus, in order for the adventurer to gain access to the Chamber of Heart.
The Misty Gateway is a portal found on Island Expeditions. It leads to and from the Quarters of the Damned in the Naglfar.

Misty Reed Farm is a farm in the Swamp of Sorrows. During the Fourth War, it was used by Varok Saurfang as a hideout after he escaped from Stormwind City. Dark Ranger Lyana and Deathguard Elites arrived here to kill Varok on orders of Sylvanas Windrunner. Lyana threatened to burn it like Teldrassil was burnt. Varok was defended by Zekhan and the Horde champion and the attackers killed. Afterwards, Varok left the farm and Zekhan returned to Orgrimmar. It used to be Misty Reed Post.
Moch'k's Hole is a cave in the Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island. It is home to Moch'k Eight-Thumbs.
Moch'k Eight-Thumbs is a trogg located in Moch'k's Hole on Mechagon Island.
Model W is a mechacycle located in Rustbolt in an alternate future of Mechagon Island.

Mists of Tirna Scithe is a dungeon in Shadowlands located in Ardenweald. Cursed to exist outside the cycle of Life and Death, the Drust seek to circumvent their fate using Ardenweald's mechanisms of Rebirth. Their would-be conquest has found its way to Tirna Scithe, where Ingra Maloch and his followers use foul magic to subjugate the local inhabitants.

__NOTOC__ Modified Earth Elemental is an earth elemental modified magically and technologically spawned by the Sambino's Modified Earth Elemental Totem. The earth elemental is there to protect The Great Sambino and Felice if someone comes to attack them. It's possible that it been placed here to avoid PK.

Mobile Mirror Set is an ability for Venthyr Covenant players that is unlocked through the Anima Conductor Rank 3 option of the Shrouded Asylum. The player has to go to the Shrouded Asylum daily to obtain a permanent buff for open world content until next reset.
Modified Impulsor is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mobius Graft is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mo'gosh Arcanists are ogres located in Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.
Mo'gosh Brutes are ogres located in Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.

Mo'gosh Ogres are ogres located in Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.
Mo'gosh Warmongers are ogres located in Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.
Mnemonic Equipment is a soulbind trait granted by Bonesmith Heirmir. When it triggers, it causes a magical copy of your weapon to appear beside you and attack your target.
__NOTOC__ Miva Star-Eye is a tauren located in Khuri's Fishing Spot in the Azure Span. She is speaking with Julk.

The mok'nathal (also spelled Mok'Nathal or Mok'Nathal Clan) are half-ogre, half-orc hybrids. Most mok'nathal are part of a clan found in Outland, though it is nearly defunct. Rexxar, the disowned son of chieftain Leoroxx, was the only remaining one left on Azeroth. Their last remaining settlement is Mok'Nathal Village in the eastern area of the Blade's Edge Mountains. According to Warrith, the mok'nathal are bitter enemies of all draenei, having hunted them all but to extinction.
Molten destroyers are the stronger, tougher brethren of the molten giants. They stand guard deeper in the Molten Core.

Mokvar the Treasurer was an orc located in the Bank of Orgrimmar found in the Valley of Strength. He was along with two Kor'kron Grunts, harassing Branzlit and Mezlik, demanding the wealth of the bank. Prior to his new title and position, he was found in Grommash Hold. He was once a member of the Veiled Blade mercenary company, and was one of the two surviving members, the other being Deliana. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, he can be killed for a key to the cages just outside.
Mograine's Might is a powerful two-handed mace. It was an excellent choice of weapon for any class that could wield it.

The Mohawk is an extremely powerful class whose attacks come from its incredibly good looking hairstyle. The Mohawk class was hacked into World of Warcraft by Mr. T, who is pretty handy with computers.
__NOTOC__ Moira Steelwing is the gryphon flight master found at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

The Molten Front is a daily zone located within the Firelands. Briefly glimpsed during the Elemental Bonds questline, it can only be accessed upon completing Calling for Reinforcements, which requires 20 Marks of the World Tree.

The Molten Flow is a massive cavern beneath the Furnace of the Molten Front. The entrance to the cave when first encountered is sealed, but during the quest Into the Fire, a Pyrelord is seen protecting the entrance. When the Pyrelord is destroyed the entrance collapses and pulls the heroes into the cavern below. Near the entrance, further up the tunnel, is Thisalee Crow. She sends the adventurers to kill the flamewakers that roam the area. Near the back of the cavern is Anren Shadowseeker, who got separated from Tholo Whitehoof while inside.

Mogu'shan Palace is a dungeon added in World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria, located within the Palace structure at the eastern edge of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. During the mogu reign over Pandaria, this palace served as the seat of power and capital of their immense empire.

Mogu Archaeology Fragment can be found at mogu dig sites all over Pandaria. Exceedingly rarely, an may spawn in place of the mogu fragment. A level 90 sha, it has 393,000 health but no special abilities.

:Keep the body strong, and the mind will follow. Mokimo the Strong is a hozen located on the Golden Terrace of the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He acts as an ambassador between the Golden Lotus and the people of Sunwalker Dezco.
Moko Powderrun is a hozen fireworks vendor located on the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Molten Quarry is a sub-zone in southeastern Ashran. A lava-filled area populated by iron-eating goren and gronnlings, featuring an extensive Ogre Mine sub-zone. The Leaping Gorger Residue and Power Geode buffs can be obtained here, and Goren Eggs looted. The inhabitants of this area are known as the Destructors fighting against the Shapers.
Molten Hide is a special exotic pet ability available exclusively to the core hound family of hunter pets, causing Fire damage to all melee attackers while active.

The Molten Shore is the southwestern cliffs of Mardum where pools of lava from the volcano flow off of the shattered world into the Twisting Nether. Inquisitor Baleful oversaw the area. A portal here was use to bring in Coilskar reinforcements.
Moist Owlettes can be by the river near Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar.
Moist Grizzlecombs are found in Moonclaw Vale in Val'sharah. They also drop from the following grell: *Wildeyed Undergrell *Crazed Undergrell

Moj'ito is a Zandalari troll located in the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax attacked the city, Moj'ito was cornered by the invading sethrak. He was rescued by the Speaker of the Horde and joined the fight alongside Princess Talanji. During Talanji's coronation, riots erupted in the Zocalo, and Moj'ito was seen kneeling.

The Mole Machine to Stormwind is a mole machine located in Shadowforge City in Blackrock Depths during Firelands (quest) and Ragnaros' Lair in the Molten Core during Molten Core (quest), and the Firelands during Firelands (quest).
Moldy Pumpkins can be found on Island Expeditions. They heals adventurers to full health.
Molten Shock is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Molten Skyfall is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Molten Sky.
Molten Blood is an Augmentation talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Regenerative Chitin.
:"In all other things, moderation." Moonfire is a druid DoT spell.
Mongoose Bite is a melee-range hunter ability. It deals nice damage, but is not generally worth running close to the enemy.

Moon Priestess Amara (or Sentinel Amara Nightwalker) is a night elf quest giver located on the road west of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. She is accompanied by two huntresses, Nhemai and Yaeliura. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Mooncleaver is created by Blacksmiths with a skill level of 375 who also have the Axesmith specialty.

Moonglow is a druid talent in the Balance tree, you will need to spend 8 points in Balance to max it. Maxing out this talent will reduce the mana cost of the associated spells by a total of 9% of their mana cost.
Monnos the Elder was an elite rare mountain giant found in Azshara.
__NOTOC__ Moon-Touched Bands drops from The Maker in the Blood Furnace wing of Hellfire Citadel on Heroic Mode.
Moongraze Woods is the forest surrounding Azure Watch in the Azuremyst Isle. It is inhabited by roaming stags, nightstalkers and lashers.
Moonchild Leggings drops from Broggok in the Blood Furnace on Heroic mode.
Moonkin Headdress is a quest reward from: *The Breaker *Mind the Gap *The Blood is Life

Monstrous Kaliri are huge kaliri bred by the arakkoa. These huge avians are bred within the bounds of Skettis itself, and are often seen patrolling the skies above the city. The Sha'tari Skyguard regularly sends daring fliers to bomb the monstrous kaliri eggs before they can hatch, thus preventing the possibility of losing any more of their numbers to them.
Moonpetal Lilies are large flowers that grow around the two ponds on the northwestern side of Aldrassil on Teldrassil. They have great healing properties.
Monstrous Felblood Snapper is a toxic fish that can be caught in the Pools of Aggonar in Hellfire Peninsula or at the Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.
Mooncloth Cowl is a reputation reward; you must be Honored with The Sha'tar to purchase it for from in Terokkar Forest.

Monster Guide II is the second unofficial RPG book after Even More Magic and Mayhem. It planned to include every Azeroth critter and monsters that weren't published in the official line.[http://forums.white-wolf.com/viewtopic.php?t=73969]
__NOTOC__ Moonglow Ink is created with Inscription (35); taught by trainers.
__NOTOC__ Moon Priestess Nici is a night elf priest who wanders around Dalaran and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.).
Monstrous Bite is a special pet ability from the Hunter pet family of Devilsaurs.
__NOTOC__ Moonglow Cuttlefish can be fished from the schools and open waters of The Frozen Sea, the southern sea of Northrend.
Moonkin Aura is a Balance druid PvP talent, available at level 30.

Moodle is a gorloc quest giver in Sholazar Basin, summoned by . He claims to have been "out in the world", and as a result is much more intelligent than most (if not all) other gorlocs. He speaks fluently compared to the fragmented, primitive phrases of his companions. He even knew of the destruction of Mosswalker Village before High-Oracle Soo-say ever did, and he appears to know quite a bit about the undead. Despite his advanced intelligence, he does not lead the Oracles, and does not even appear to have a position of any power. This may be due to his implied anger problem, as he is referred to as "the angry gorloc", and the object used to summon him is his stress ball.

Moonleaf is found around the Blackwald in Gilneas. These simple leaves grow by Elune's grace, and only near Tal'doren. They can help feral worgen's mind to understand the need for balance and their soul can permanently earn mastery over the beast. Ingesting this plant is said to produce a feeling of inner calm.
Moon-Kissed Clay can be gathered around Astranaar in Ashenvale. It also drops from the nearby Astranaar Skirmishers.
The Monstrous Egg rarely drops from specific dungeon bosses of your level if you have the Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide in your bags.
Moon Priestess Tharill is a dying night elf quest giver located in Darkshore.
Monstrous Parrots can be found flying within the Ironclad Cove in the Deadmines.
